Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

The mission of our team is to build a scalable and secure AI platform that enables security teams across Robinhood to develop and operate AI-powered agents and security solutions with confidence.

As a Software Engineer on the AI Security team, you’ll help build the foundational platform, infrastructure, and security primitives that make it easier for teams to develop AI-powered security capabilities at scale. You’ll work on complex engineering problems at the intersection of AI, distributed systems, and security, with a particular focus on areas such as identity, authentication, authorization, encryption, and platform safety.

You’ll partner closely with security and engineering teams across Robinhood to create systems that make AI development easier while ensuring security is built into the platform from the start. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys building platforms, solving complex technical problems, and helping shape how AI is securely adopted across security.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA and Bellevue, WA office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

 

What you’ll do

  • Design and build a scalable AI platform that enables security teams to develop, deploy, and operate AI-powered agents and security capabilities
  • Build foundational platform services, APIs, libraries, and SDKs that make it easier for teams to integrate AI into security workflows
  • Design secure systems with strong identity, authentication, authorization, encryption, and data protection controls
  • Build and operate reliable, large-scale distributed systems that support AI-powered security use cases
  • Develop platform capabilities and guardrails that enable teams to safely build and operate AI agents
  • Partner with security, infrastructure, and engineering teams to understand their needs and translate them into reusable platform capabilities
  • Identify opportunities to improve platform performance, developer experience, reliability, and security through automation
  • Help shape the technical direction and architecture of Robinhood’s AI Security platform as the team and platform continue to grow

 

What you bring

  • 3+ years of software development experience
  • 2+ years of experience building large-scale distributed systems, with experience designing systems around security concepts such as authentication, authorization, identity, or encryption
  • Experience building AI platforms, AI infrastructure, or production systems that support AI-powered applications or agents
  • Proficiency in Go or Python, with strong problem-solving and production debugging skills
  • Experience with cloud-native platforms and distributed systems technologies such as AWS, Kubernetes, gRPC, or Kafka
  • Strong understanding of security fundamentals and experience incorporating security into the design of production systems
  • Experience designing and building reusable platform capabilities, APIs, libraries, or developer tooling
  • Proven experience delivering large engineering projects with meaningful, long-term impact
  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to make thoughtful trade-offs across security, reliability, scalability, and developer experience
  • Ability to solve complex engineering problems and collaborate effectively across security and engineering teams

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching
  • Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents
  • Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds.
  • Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. 
  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

The successful candidate will not only manage daily operational workflows and risk monitoring but will also lead the digital transformation of these functions.   • Financial Acumen: Good understanding of P&L attribution, financial controls, market risk indicators (Greeks, VaR), financial markets and products.

  • Capacity: Ability to thrive in a high-intensity environment requiring extended hours when necessary to meet global trading demands.

We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle.

You’ll be part of a hybrid-friendly environment where your unique talents and insights will play a crucial role in building something extraordinary.

 

Head of Tokenization

Company description:

Elliptic is the leader in digital asset decisioning, we have built the most comprehensive platform for efficiently extracting crypto data and intelligence across blockchains with the greatest accuracy.

Our platform’s unrivalled uptime, scalability, depth and breadth of our data and intelligence means exacting organizations choose Elliptic for their compliance, risk management, intelligence operations and blockchain infrastructure needs.

Founded in 2013, Elliptic is headquartered in London with offices in New York, Washington D.C., Miami, San Francisco, UAE, Singapore, Hong Kong and Tokyo. To learn more, visit www.elliptic.co and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Are you a proactive, customer-centric professional with deep SaaS renewal and retention experience and someone who naturally raises the game of everyone around you? Are you looking for a role where you keep a hand on a strategic book of business and help shape how the wider team works? If yes, we want to hear from you!

The impact you will have:

As a Senior Customer Success Manager (Player-Coach), you'll carry a portfolio of strategic mid-market accounts across APAC while also acting as a force multiplier for the broader CS team - sharing playbooks, modeling best practice, and helping newer or peer CSMs level up. This is not a people-management role: you won't own headcount, hiring, or formal performance management. Instead, your leadership shows up through influence, mentorship, and being the practitioner other CSMs turn to when a deal, a renewal, or an escalation gets hard.

What you will do:

As a practitioner (your own book of business):

  • Own the health, retention, and expansion pipeline across your mid-market portfolio, tracking customer performance, engagement, and satisfaction to proactively mitigate risk and uncover opportunities for growth.

  • Serve as the strategic point of contact for your in-region customers - building strong relationships with both operational and executive stakeholders, guiding them toward best practices, and ensuring their ongoing success with Elliptic.

  • Develop and maintain structured account plans for your key customers, articulating goals, success metrics, and long-term strategies to drive adoption, value realization, and renewal readiness.

  • Lead renewal cycles end-to-end for your accounts, maintaining an accurate retention forecast and negotiating commercial terms that align customer needs with Elliptic's business objectives.

  • Identify and champion expansion opportunities within your own portfolio, partnering with Product to position additional solutions.

  • Run strategic business reviews and success discussions that demonstrate ROI and reinforce Elliptic's value as a trusted long-term partner.

As a coach (raising the team's game):

  • Act as a go-to subject-matter expert for peers - offering guidance on complex renewals, escalations, or stakeholder situations when asked, without owning the outcome for other CSMs' accounts.

  • Model and share best practices for account planning, health-score interpretation, and renewal forecasting, helping standardize how the team approaches strategic retention.

  • Partner with your manager to help onboard and ramp new CSMs - shadowing calls, reviewing account plans, or being a sounding board.

  • Contribute to and help evolve regional playbooks, tools, and enablement content based on what's actually working in the field.

  • Represent the voice of the CSM team in cross-functional forums (Sales, Product, Solutions, Marketing), surfacing patterns and insights from across the team's accounts, not just your own.

What you will achieve in the first 6 months:

  • Within your first six months, you'll have fully ramped up on your portfolio - with account plans in place for every key customer, a clear view of health and renewal risk across the book, and at least one renewal or expansion successfully closed. You'll have built credibility with peers as a go-to resource on complex renewals or escalations, contributed at least one improvement to the team's shared playbooks or tools, and be actively participating in cross-functional forums as a voice for the CS team's collective insight, all while maintaining strong, trust-based relationships with your own customers' key stakeholders.

You will be a great fit here if you:

  • Take a strategic, consultative approach to Customer Success, building long-term partnerships that deliver measurable value.

  • Naturally gravitate toward helping others get better, influencing through credibility rather than formal authority.

  • Build strong relationships across stakeholder levels - from analysts to executives and tailor communication to influence effectively.

  • Are outcome-driven, balancing tactical ownership of your own book with informal, influence-based leadership across the team.

  • Lead confidently on success planning, value realization, and strategic direction, with a calm and empathetic presence in escalations.

  • Are comfortable with the "player-coach" duality: evaluated on your own portfolio first, with mentorship as an added dimension.

Our ideal candidate has:

  • Native Mandarin speaker.

  • Proven experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Renewals within B2B SaaS, managing mid-market customers with complex workflows.

  • A track record of being the person peers informally seek out for advice, even without a formal title reflecting that.

  • Strong retention and renewal strategy skills, with accurate pipeline forecasting and demonstrated ability to drive expansion.

  • Fluent in using AI-based tools for customer insights, health scoring, and workflow automation to scale a strategic book of business.

  • Experience running executive-level business reviews, with a commercial mindset for negotiating customer and company needs.

  • Comfort operating without formal management authority - leading through credibility and example, in a global, cross-functional environment.

Bonus Points for:

  • Knowledge or experience in AML, particularly within crypto or financial services.

  • Familiarity with blockchain, Web3, or digital assets.

  • An interest in public speaking and representing the company at industry events.

  • Prior experience in a player-coach, team lead, or "senior IC with informal mentorship" capacity.

About Us

DriveWealth is on a mission to make investing easier. We believe that everyone should have the ability to control their financial future, and that access to financial markets should not be limited by geography, wealth, or legacy systems. We are a global B2B financial technology organization dedicated to democratizing access to financial independence around the world. Our mission is realized through an API-based platform, empowering our partners to offer seamless investing and trading experiences to clients worldwide, all from their mobile devices. Our technology provides partners with a modern, extensible toolkit, enabling traditional investment workflows and innovative techniques like fractional share ownership. DriveWealth has evolved into a global platform offering trading of US equities, mutual funds, ETFs, fixed income, and options.

There’s never been a better time to build a category-defining business and there has rarely been a team better positioned for this opportunity. Our culture blends the pace and agility of a fintech start-up with the impact, stability, and discipline of Wall Street. We encourage creativity and experimentation while ensuring institutional-grade execution and regulatory compliance in everything we do. Join us and help build the future of global investing!

Join our dynamic, fast-growing fintech company that's revolutionizing financial services through technology. As Director of Engineering, you will be a senior leader responsible for shaping the vision and execution of our engineering organization and drive innovation and operational excellence across our critical systems. You will be responsible for solution architecture for critical business initiatives, including expansion of new products while driving a culture of engineering quality, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. Partnering with other engineering managers, you will align technology initiatives with our ambitious growth strategy, ensuring our platforms remain robust, scalable, and secure.

If you are passionate about building and scaling high-performance financial infrastructure and aligning technology execution with business outcomes, this is an opportunity to have a transformational impact on the future of our brokerage platform.

What You’ll Do

  • Architectural Excellence: Oversee the design and development of scalable, resilient, and secure systems, leveraging modern architectures such as microservices, API-driven, and event-driven designs
  • Platform & Partner Account Architecture: Lead solution architecture for sub-account and partner-level ledger capabilities, enabling multi-tenant account structuring across the brokerage platform
  • Execute the Strategic Vision for the Brokerage Platform: Deliver critical business-driven products and enhancements across multiple asset classes and other product features. Experience with Digital Assets, Options or Reg-T Margin is a huge plus
  • Core Platform Development: Contribute to the development of architecture framework, common libraries, developer tools to improve developer velocity
  • AI/Automation: Identify and execute opportunities to embed Agentic AI/automation in business processes and products

## About Polymarket

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. ## About the Role

When something goes wrong for a customer and the normal path hasn't fixed it, the case lands with you. You'll own how Polymarket handles escalations and formal complaints end to end: intake, classification, resolution, root cause analysis, and reporting. The scope covers trust, safety, and community concerns alongside standard customer disputes, and it has to meet regulatory and audit expectations. Documentation discipline matters as much as resolution speed here.

This is a build role. Polymarket's CX function is growing, and a formal escalations and complaints program doesn't fully exist yet. You'll define what gets escalated, how, and to whom, set service levels, and make sure every case file is clean enough to hand to a regulator. You'll work closely with Legal, Compliance, Trust and Safety, Product, and Engineering, which means you need to be as comfortable writing a case summary for outside counsel as you are talking a frustrated customer off a ledge.

The right person for this role is a steady hand with a strong sense of fairness and a track record of building complaint programs in regulated environments. If you've spent years cleaning up other people's escalation messes and have opinions about how to do it right, this is your chance to build it from scratch.

## What You'll Do

  • Define and own the escalations process: what triggers an escalation, who handles it, and what the resolution timeline looks like at each severity level.
  • Build the complaints program from the ground up, including intake, classification, tracking, and resolution workflows that satisfy regulatory and audit requirements.
  • Personally handle the most sensitive and highest-stakes customer cases, including those involving regulatory referrals or formal consumer complaints.
  • Partner with Trust and Safety and Community teams to manage concerns that arrive through support channels and require cross-functional coordination.
  • Analyze complaint and escalation trends, identify root causes, and drive fixes with Product, Engineering, and Policy.
  • Maintain complete, accurate case records and produce reporting that Legal, Compliance, and external auditors can rely on.
  • Train front-line agents and AI systems on escalation criteria, handoff procedures, and documentation standards so the program works at scale.

## What We're Looking For

  • 4 or more years in escalations, complaints management, or customer resolution at a fintech, bank, brokerage, or other regulated company.
  • Direct experience building or running a formal complaints program, including intake design, case tracking, and regulatory reporting.
  • Strong written communication skills, particularly in sensitive situations where tone and precision both matter.
  • Rigorous documentation habits and a clear understanding of what "audit-ready" actually means in practice.
  • Sound judgment and a consistent sense of fairness when cases are ambiguous or emotionally charged.
  • Comfort working directly with Legal and Compliance teams, including translating case details into formats they can act on.
  • (Plus) Experience handling regulator-referred or formal consumer complaints, such as CFPB or state-level filings.
  • (Plus) Background in Trust and Safety or community moderation, especially in a platform or marketplace context.
